school.school_name: 専門学校埼玉自動車大学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Verify that an official disclosure-page target-form PDF remains review-bound when its only 令和8 text is an incidental committee-term date, not target-fiscal-year evidence.
steps: Use the Saitama official-index URL registered as the school's prefecture_aggregator disclosure site.
Open the school evaluation/disclosure page and inspect the anchor labeled 更新確認申請書.
Extract the PDF text and confirm it is a 様式第2号 target-form bundle for 専門学校埼玉自動車大学校.
Inspect the 令和8 occurrence and confirm it appears only in a school-evaluation committee term such as 令和8年3月31日.
Classify it as needs_operator_review because incidental term dates do not prove FY2026 target-year eligibility.

reusable_rules: Keep 更新確認申請書 anchors as high-value target-form candidates.
Inspect the local context around any target-year token before accepting it as fiscal-year evidence.
Route target-form PDFs to needs_operator_review when the only target-year token appears in committee terms, appointment periods, or other non-application contexts.
anti_patterns: Do not treat every 令和8 occurrence inside a target-form PDF as FY2026 application evidence.
Do not use committee appointment periods such as 令和8年3月31日 as target fiscal-year evidence.
Do not infer target FY from the generic filename koutoumusyou.pdf.

evidence.notes: Windows v333 Saitama 50-site replay records this candidate as reason=target_fiscal_year_not_detected, pdf_type=target. Manual PyMuPDF extraction found readable target-form text and a 令和8 occurrence only in the context 令和7年4月1日〜令和8年3月31日 for a school-evaluation committee member term.
